fact: The Secretary General of Diffa region said about three million Nigeriens currently hold a national identity card, out of an estimated 13 million potentially concerned; against the 27.9 million population that is about 10.8% (computed here).

The DGATDD says about 3,000,000 of the 13 million Nigeriens old enough for the national ID card do not yet hold one, so about 10 million hold one, roughly 36% of the 27.9 million population (derived by dividing by the stated population).
